All three fixes are in. `uv run pytest -q` gives 264 passed, 53 skipped (262 before plus my 2 new tests). `uv run ruff check arena_kit/agents/final.py tests/test_final.py` passes. I didn't run `arena run`.

**`/home/fpvmaster/fpvmaster/EHL_HACKATHON_FINALE/MUCHackatonFinal/agent/arena_kit/agents/final.py`**
1. **`_value_match`:** a fallback sheet is now sent only if it is unsent, passes `must_haves_ok`, and has `_value(case, std_full, t) >= a * (1 - TOL)`. If none qualifies for a thread, that thread contributes nothing, so `_close` can return None and fall through to the must-have rescue, walk or follow.
2. **`_target`:** it returns `ours[-1]` early when `ours and ours[-1] >= a*(1-TOL)`, before the `moves_left` override.
3. **`_sheets`:** it returns `[]` up front if any sheet we already sent has value `>= a*(1-TOL)`, using the same `a` the function already computes. `decide` then goes to `_close`, which accepts the standing sheet if it is acceptable.
4. **`reprice`:** it now uses `if not slope > 0: return None`, so a NaN slope is skipped.

I did not use your suggested `_sheets` guard (`o <= ours[-1]` plus a sheet at that value already sent), because it didn't catch the case in my test. The sheets we had sent came from earlier builder runs. A new `build(o)` at the same value put a cheaper price-only sheet (27.20, value roughly equal to ours) first, and that sheet was not in `seen`. So `sheets[0] in seen` was False and a near-duplicate went out. Checking "any sent sheet already meets their ask within tolerance" closes that gap. The one difference: the check uses the lowest value across all their sheets, which is how `a` is already computed in `_sheets`.

**`/home/fpvmaster/fpvmaster/EHL_HACKATHON_FINALE/MUCHackatonFinal/agent/tests/test_final.py`** (imports `TOL` and `case_c_open` added)

- `test_target_does_not_push_above_their_ask_once_it_is_met`: our sheet is 0.5% under their ask. It checks that `_target` returns our standing value and `_sheets` returns `[]`. `decide` then either accepts or sends nothing worth more than `a`.
